newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan continued its uptrend to close at 8.2979 against the U.S. dollar on Monday from last Friday's 8.2985 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market.
The yuan opened at an intra-day high of 8.2970 but fell to hit an intra-day low of 8.2986 early in the session. It then consolidated between 8.2975 and 8.2980 for rest of the session.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.2980, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan is continuing its steady rise since breaching the key 8.3000 resistance level last Thursday.
"Some people think the yuan has finished its consolidation around 8.30 and is on its way up again," said one dealer.
"The yuan's rise was promoted by less selling, which indicated the intervention by the central bank has become weaker," he added.
The yuan closed down at 7.3300 from 7.2843 against 100 Japanese yen and down at an intra-day low of 1.0740 from 1.0723 against the Hong Kong dollar.
